Note: Bruce Railsback maintains that a table of time boundaries like the one
below is of little use because the substage designations label excursions
(highs and lows), not the boundaries between. The excursions (peaks and
valleys) are distinct and easy to label, but the boundaries are commonly
gradational, so that choosing one moment in time for them is subjective.
Furthermore, improved age models will in the future make any table of
boundary ages obsolete, even though the substages' numbers and letters
themselves will probably not need revision because it is unlikely that new
excursions will become evident.  The table below was generated only to
satisfy requests by persons who disagree.
